title: View upcoming EMI details for an active loan
preconditions: User logged in with active loan account LN-45678, next EMI due on 15-Feb-2025
steps:
1. Navigate to Loans section
2. Select loan account LN-45678
3. Click on 'View EMI Details'
expected_result: EMI details displayed showing: Amount: ₹5,250.00, Due Date: 15-Feb-2025, Principal: ₹3,800.00, Interest: ₹1,450.00, Outstanding Balance: ₹1,25,000.00

title: Make successful EMI payment with sufficient balance
preconditions: User logged in, loan LN-45678 has EMI due ₹5,250.00, savings account SAV-1001 has balance ₹15,000.00
steps:
1. Go to EMI payment screen for loan LN-45678
2. Select payment account SAV-1001
3. Verify amount shows ₹5,250.00
4. Click 'Pay Now'
5. Confirm payment
expected_result: Payment successful message displayed with transaction reference (e.g., TXN987654321), account SAV-1001 debited ₹5,250.00, new balance ₹9,750.00, loan outstanding reduced to ₹1,19,750.00, next EMI date updated to 15-Mar-2025

title: Payment fails when account has insufficient balance
preconditions: User logged in, loan LN-45678 EMI due ₹5,250.00, savings account SAV-2002 balance ₹2,100.00
steps:
1. Navigate to EMI payment for loan LN-45678
2. Select payment account SAV-2002
3. Click 'Pay Now'
4. Confirm payment
test_data: loan_account = LN-45678; payment_account = SAV-2002 (balance = 2,100.00); emi_amount = 5,250.00; shortfall = 3,150.00
expected_result: Error message: 'Insufficient balance. Available: ₹2,100.00, Required: ₹5,250.00'. Payment not processed, no debit from SAV-2002, loan status unchanged

title: Prevent duplicate payment for already paid EMI
preconditions: User logged in, loan LN-45678 current EMI already paid on 10-Feb-2025 with transaction TXN111222333
steps:
1. Go to loan LN-45678 EMI payment screen
2. Attempt to make payment again
3. Select account SAV-1001 and click 'Pay Now'
test_data: loan_account = LN-45678; previous_payment_date = 10-Feb-2025; previous_txn = TXN111222333; payment_account = SAV-1001
expected_result: Message displayed: 'Current EMI already paid on 10-Feb-2025 (Ref: TXN111222333). Next EMI due: 15-Mar-2025'. Payment button disabled or payment blocked

title: Verify payment history shows all completed EMI transactions
preconditions: User logged in, loan LN-45678 has 3 EMI payments completed
steps:
1. Navigate to loan LN-45678
2. Click 'Payment History'
3. Review transaction list
test_data: loan_account = LN-45678; payment_1 = {date: 15-Dec-2024, amount: 5,250.00, ref: TXN001}; payment_2 = {date: 15-Jan-2025, amount: 5,250.00, ref: TXN002}; payment_3 = {date: 10-Feb-2025, amount: 5,250.00, ref: TXN003}
expected_result: Payment history displays 3 transactions in reverse chronological order with Date, Amount, Transaction Reference, and Status (Success) for each entry

title: Handle payment timeout during transaction processing
preconditions: User logged in, loan LN-45678 EMI ₹5,250.00 due, account SAV-1001 balance ₹10,000.00, simulate network timeout after payment initiation
steps:
1. Go to EMI payment screen
2. Select account SAV-1001
3. Click 'Pay Now' and confirm
4. Simulate timeout (wait 60 seconds without response)
test_data: loan_account = LN-45678; payment_account = SAV-1001; emi_amount = 5,250.00; timeout_duration = 60 seconds
expected_result: Timeout error message: 'Payment request timed out. Please check payment status before retrying.' Payment status shows 'Pending' or 'In Progress', user can check transaction status separately, no duplicate debit occurs

title: Validate payment amount cannot be modified by user
preconditions: User logged in, loan LN-45678 EMI amount ₹5,250.00
steps:
1. Navigate to EMI payment screen for loan LN-45678
2. Check if amount field is editable
3. Attempt to change amount value (if field appears editable)
expected_result: EMI amount field is read-only/disabled showing ₹5,250.00. User cannot modify the amount. If modification attempted, system rejects with error: 'EMI amount cannot be changed'

title: Download payment receipt after successful EMI payment
preconditions: User logged in, EMI payment completed for loan LN-45678 with transaction TXN987654321
steps:
1. Go to payment confirmation screen or payment history
2. Locate transaction TXN987654321
3. Click 'Download Receipt' or 'View Receipt'
test_data: loan_account = LN-45678; transaction_ref = TXN987654321; payment_date = 10-Feb-2025; amount = 5,250.00; from_account = SAV-1001
expected_result: Receipt PDF/document downloads containing: Transaction Ref: TXN987654321, Date: 10-Feb-2025, Loan Account: LN-45678, Amount Paid: ₹5,250.00, From Account: SAV-1001, Principal: ₹3,800.00, Interest: ₹1,450.00

title: Payment fails when selecting a closed/inactive account
preconditions: User logged in, loan LN-45678 EMI ₹5,250.00 due, account SAV-9999 is closed/inactive
steps:
1. Navigate to EMI payment screen
2. Attempt to select closed account SAV-9999 from dropdown
3. If selectable, proceed to payment confirmation
test_data: loan_account = LN-45678; payment_account = SAV-9999 (status = Closed); emi_amount = 5,250.00
expected_result: Closed account SAV-9999 either not shown in account dropdown, or if shown, payment blocked with error: 'Selected account is inactive. Please choose an active account'

title: Verify loan balance updates correctly after partial prepayment vs regular EMI
preconditions: User logged in, loan LN-45678 outstanding ₹1,25,000.00, regular EMI ₹5,250.00
steps:
1. Make regular EMI payment of ₹5,250.00
2. Verify outstanding balance
3. Note principal component ₹3,800.00
test_data: loan_account = LN-45678; initial_outstanding = 1,25,000.00; emi_amount = 5,250.00; principal_component = 3,800.00; interest_component = 1,450.00
expected_result: After payment, outstanding balance = ₹1,21,200.00 (reduced by principal ₹3,800.00 only, not full EMI amount). Next EMI details updated showing new principal/interest split

title: Handle payment when EMI amount is exactly equal to account balance
preconditions: User logged in, loan LN-45678 EMI ₹5,250.00, account SAV-3003 balance exactly ₹5,250.00
steps:
1. Go to EMI payment screen
2. Select account SAV-3003
3. Click 'Pay Now' and confirm
expected_result: Payment successful, transaction reference generated, SAV-3003 balance becomes ₹0.00, loan outstanding reduced appropriately, confirmation message displayed

title: Payment fails with specific error when bank server returns failure code
preconditions: User logged in, loan LN-45678 EMI ₹5,250.00, account SAV-1001 balance ₹10,000.00, simulate bank server error response
steps:
1. Navigate to EMI payment
2. Select account SAV-1001
3. Click 'Pay Now' and confirm
4. Simulate server error (e.g., error code 500 or payment gateway failure)
test_data: loan_account = LN-45678; payment_account = SAV-1001; emi_amount = 5,250.00; simulated_error_code = BANK_ERR_500
expected_result: Error message: 'Payment failed due to technical issue. Please try again later. If amount debited, it will be reversed in 24-48 hours.' Payment status = Failed, no debit from account, loan status unchanged
